full_judgment: 17. In the instant case from the judgment of the Tribunal as affirmed by the Appellate Division it is found that the election was set aside and the election having been declared as a whole void with a direction to hold the election of Kalapaharia Union Parishad without any limitation attached to it. The learned Advocate for the petitioner submitted that during the pendency of the Rule issued in Writ Petition No. 721 of 1995 of similar nature the petitioner who paid up the loan money of the bank before the filing of the nomination paper for the election was allowed to participate in the election by an order of the court. In the affidavit-in-reply filed on behalf of the petitioner in reply to the affidavit-in-opposition on behalf of the respondent No. 2 on 5.9.1995 the Gazette Notification has been annexed as Annexure-J which was made in respect of the election of Ramkhana Union Parishad PS Nageshari, District-Kurigram. As the Election Tribunal has passed the order of holding election of the concerned Union Parishad without any limitation we are of the view that the petitioner has ceased to suffer from the disqualification as provided under section 7 (1)(g) of the Ordinance, 1983.
